name: openlinear
description: Open-source project management with projects, milestones, issues, and boards. Run locally with SQLite or collaborate online, with REST API and MCP access.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs && npm run build -w @openlinear/domain && npm run build -w @openlinear/contracts && npm run build -w @openlinear/db && npm run build -w @openlinear/ui && npm run build -w @openlinear/test-fixtures && npm run build -w @openlinear/hosted && npm run build -w @openlinear/api && npm run build -w @openlinear/hosted-service && npm run build -w @openlinear/operator && npm run build -w @openlinear/web
scripts.build:vercel:development: node scripts/validate-hosted-environments.mjs --build development && npm run build:hosted:vercel -w @openlinear/web
scripts.build:vercel:production: node scripts/validate-hosted-environments.mjs --build production && npm run build:hosted:vercel -w @openlinear/web
scripts.test:hosted-rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-openlinear --only firestore "npx vitest run packages/hosted/tests/firestore-rules.emulator.test.ts --config vitest.firestore.config.ts"
scripts.test:hosted-transactions: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-openlinear --only firestore "npx vitest run apps/hosted-service/tests/firestore-collaboration.emulator.test.ts --config vitest.firestore.config.ts"
